newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's PSG links up with Jersey asset manager.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's PSG links up with Jersey asset manager.

text.p: PAG Ltd offshoot Professional Securities Group Ltd (PSG) said it had formed a separate asset management company and linked up with a Jersey-based asset manager.
PSG, which is owned by its own management team and PAG on a 50-50 basis, has created PSG Asset Management and formed a strategic alliance with Ashburton (Jersey) Ltd of the Channel Islands.
Formed in March this year, PSG has assets worth 1.5 billion rand under management.

"Through our association with Ashburton (Jersey) Ltd, our South African clients will have access to top performing international investment funds," PSG Managing Director Jaap du Toit said in a statement.
"This alliance will also ensure international exposure for PSG Asset Management in preparation for the dismantling of foreign exchange controls."
